title: Exception context suppressed: 1 raise without `from` (L703)
detail: Raising a new exception inside an `except` block without `raise NewExc() from exc` discards the original traceback. Suggested fix: add `from exc` or `from None`.

title: Static method(s) use `self`/`cls` as first argument at L141,L790,L826
detail: Static methods at multiple locations declare `self` or `cls` as their first parameter, but since they are `@staticmethod`, no instance or class is passed — the parameter receives the first positional argument instead, silently misrouting values. This is a common copy-paste error from instance methods. Suggested fix: rename the parameter or convert to an instance/class method.

title: getattr() with constant attribute name at L819
detail: Using `getattr(obj, 'literal_name')` provides no safety benefit over direct attribute access. Suggested fix: use direct attribute access.
